headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate advanced risk assessment features using AI to provide deeper insights into potential vulnerabilities and risks during npm/PyPI installations. Leverage machine learning models for better prediction of binding.gyp command expansions, enhancing user security and confidence.
actions: Implement an AI-driven risk scoring system that evaluates the safety and reliability of packages based on public data and historical usage patterns.
Develop a predictive model to anticipate potential issues with binding.gyp commands, providing users with real-time alerts and suggestions for safer alternative
